assessor.name: Codex active session
assessor.context: Same session that prepared and reviewed these development cases. No independent, blinded or held-out claim. Batch-close review checked all B outputs against the established policy-4 continuing-preview precedent; earlier sentence-omission judgments and dependent comparisons are superseded without changing the frozen policy.

setup.reason: This no-CW control has only the five built-in skills in its initial catalog, no CW body exposure, and matching gpt-5.6-sol/low context. Frozen source/task identities and the complete retained report establish valid setup; TASK.md remains unchanged.

criteria.reason: The complete output retains the evidence, limits, opt-in context and approval/review gates, but loses the assignment to Nia to send approved invitations. Nia is assigned only consent and switch-back checks; no part of the report identifies the invitation sender. The continuing-preview context is accepted under the established policy-4 whole-document precedent and is not a separate defect.
criteria.consequence: Required source information is missing, so the functional outcome fails regardless of shortening.

criteria.reason: After checks and approval, the manager no longer has the source’s named owner for sending invitations. The edit retains readiness-check owners but leaves this next action unassigned. This is a concrete responsibility loss, distinct from the accepted omission of a standalone continuation sentence.
criteria.consequence: The manager must reconstruct the invitation-sending responsibility; this is the same omission as F1, not a second failed execution.

criteria.reason: The decision, evidence bullets, approval checks and follow-up are easy to navigate. The missing sending responsibility affects fidelity and usefulness, while the remaining material is coherently organized and readable.
criteria.consequence: Required for the corresponding functional or invocation outcome; reported separately.

procedural_summary: No-CW control. The trace shows a baseline commit, full source reading, report edit and diff inspection; no expressed unresolved framing uncertainty. These visible comparison steps did not preserve all consequential source information.

observations.description: Whole-document word counts: source 279, output 242, change -37; shorter. Length is unscored.
observations.consequence: Descriptive comparison; no separate score or automatic length-based preference.

observations.description: Both skill-bearing first-repetition outputs keep the invitation sender: original says Nia can send invitations and rewrite likewise names Nia after checks and approval. The control does not. One repetition does not establish a reliable CW effect.
observations.consequence: Descriptive comparison; no separate score or automatic length-based preference.
